sculpt_briar_thicket.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_briar_thicket.notes: Briar thicket for the bramble puzzles (gameplay/wilds-puzzles.js): arching bramble canes with hooked prickles, three-leaflet leaves (green / bronze / dried), berry clusters, dead sticks. Origin = ground centre (the chest), dome ~3.4 m x ~2.1 m. Leaves are a single sheet: the game draws BriarLeaf double-sided. LOD tris 21108 / 6209 / 1242. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
